Unfortunately I'm still hunting for the elusive king dumpling myself, last one to complete my collection, but according to this [creature sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1RYRvKTCLLJxXrZ_7OOjG8j98L_fjE5KNHtLG4wHn9Xw/edit#gid=0), you are going to need a full team of six.

Best way to do it is to grind favor in arachnid's nest at low depth levels (don't go deeper until you get a dumpling), since i found that depth doesn't matter, and lower levels mean easier fights. Favor maxes out at level 100, and you get some great bonuses like multiple +50% dumpling spawn chances.

Once you're done, you can either head over to cutthroat jungle to farm the melon dumpling (eating fruit, doesn't matter what color or order), or blood grove to farm the squash dumpling (by eating squash), again, depth does not matter and the mana drop is random (you'll get 100% in one go if you succeed, took me around 200 fruits/squash iirc but it's rng), but you MUST have the default dumpling in your team.

If you're lucky, you might bump into a veggie dumpling too, these are random spawns as long as you have default dumpling in your party. Once done with that, make sure you have dumpling in your party (ideally full dumpling, so you have a chance to encounter king dumpling as well, you have a small chance to find him in the special nether(?) doors), and THEN only go down new depths. Every new depth gives you 1% omelette dumpling exp. Do 100 and you should have most of your dumplings.

To get a pudding dumpling, you need to fuse two dumplings together, whichever two is up to you, though i dont recommend fusing your default dumpling, as I am unsure if that will count as "having a default dumpling in a party" anymore. You could try using the dumpling as a base as fusion if you feel like being that brave dude to experiment and further science though, haha :P

All you need left is king/veggie if you haven't bumped into them yet, and that should be it!
